entries.name: Arazzo Specification
entries.versionBasis: spec.openapis.org/arazzo/latest.html is 'The Arazzo Specification v1.1.0', matching GitHub release 1.1.0 (2026-05-18); 1.0.1 was 2025-01-20.

licence.basis: GitHub licence metadata for the official OAI/Arazzo-Specification repo reports Apache-2.0, from its LICENSE file.

norn.overlap: multi-step API workflows, step dependencies, success/failure criteria

entries.notes: The 1.1 JSON Schema URL could not be found (spec.openapis.org/arazzo/1.1/schema/ returned 404). Arazzo 1.1 adds async step coordination guidance.

entries.name: AsyncAPI Specification
entries.versionBasis: asyncapi/spec GitHub release v3.1.0 (2026-01-31); spec/asyncapi.md reads 'Version 3.1.0', and asyncapi.com's 'latest' reference redirects to v3.1.0.

licence.basis: Read the asyncapi/spec LICENSE (Apache License 2.0) and the spec text 'The AsyncAPI Specification is licensed under The Apache License, Version 2.0'; the spec-json-schemas repo is also Apache-2.0.

norn.overlap: event/message channel descriptions, operations, message schemas, broker bindings

entries.notes: The JSON Schemas ship as a separate package (spec-json-schemas v6.11.1, 2026-01-30).

entries.name: OpenAPI Specification
entries.versionBasis: spec.openapis.org/oas/latest.html is 'OpenAPI Specification v3.2.1' (publishDate 2026-09-10), matching GitHub release 3.2.1; 3.1.2 was the last 3.1.x (2025-09-19).

licence.basis: The published 3.2.1 spec states 'This document is licensed under The Apache License, Version 2.0', and the OAI/OpenAPI-Specification repo licence is Apache-2.0.

norn.overlap: HTTP API descriptions, operations, schemas, security schemes

priority.reason: Norn emits OpenAPI; connectors and capabilities need OpenAPI ingress.

entries.notes: The OAS 3.2 JSON Schema id is dated 2025-09-17 and returns HTTP 200. We did not check whether a newer schema iteration exists for 3.2.1.

entries.name: Semantic Sensor Network Ontology (SSN) incl. SOSA
entries.versionBasis: w3.org/TR/vocab-ssn/ is the 'W3C Recommendation 19 October 2017 (Link errors corrected 08 December 2017)'; a 'Semantic Sensor Network Ontology - 2023 Edition' exists only as a draft at w3c.github.io/sdw-sosa-ssn.

licence.text: W3C Software and Document License (2015) for ontology files, also OGC Software licence; W3C document use rules for the spec
licence.basis: Read the SOSA ontology at w3.org/ns/sosa/ (dcterms:license <http://www.w3.org/Consortium/Legal/2015/copyright-software-and-document> and <http://www.opengeospatial.org/ogc/Software>, rights 'Copyright 2017 W3C/OGC') and the Recommendation's copyright notice.

norn.overlap: sensors, observations, samples, actuations, observable properties, platforms

priority.reason: Assay and scale observations are SOSA observations.

entries.notes: The 2023-edition draft (OGC/W3C, copyright 2026) adds new version IRIs and is not yet a Recommendation. The W3C licence page was not opened separately; the SPDX id comes from the licence IRI in the ontology.
